description_excerpt: Job Description Samples Handling & Weighing: - Receive homogenized samples from the samples grinding staffs samples Weighing Leader - Check and record samples status: sample code, date received, sample type,... - Weigh samples into suitable containers following the specified analytical portion for each test. - Label test portion containers clearly with sample IDs and analysis information. - Record weights accurately in a weight records/worksheets or LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) - Store samples in the right place and control the storage conditions, and/or deliver to the…
